{{Youmay|the [[Gambler/Legends|gambler]] Zarro Flynn|[[Zarro]], a [[human]], or other uses of the word [[Flynn (disambiguation)]]|linebreak=1}}
'''Zarro Flynn''' was a [[Gambler/Legends|gambler]] who organized an invitation-only [[Zarro Flynn's sabacc tournament|tournament]] for the game [[Sabacc/Legends|sabacc]] on<ref name="Mission">{{TORcite|type=crewskill|Underworld Trading|Into the Sabacc Pit}}</ref> the [[Hutt Space/Legends|Hutt Space]]<ref name="Atlas">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]]<ref name="Mission" /> by [[3643 BBY]].<ref name="Date">Per the reasoning [[Template:TOR_dates|here]], Act I of ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' takes place around [[3643 BBY]]. Since players of ''The Old Republic'' can assign their companions on the mission "Into the Sabacc Pit" independently of the main class storyline at any point during the [[Star Wars video games|game]], the mission must take place at some point around 3643 [[Galactic Standard Calendar|BBY]].</ref>

{{GameMechanics|legends=1}}
Around that [[Standard year/Legends|year]],<ref name="Date" /> an individual associated with one of the two rival governments in the ongoing [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] sent a companion of theirs to Flynn's tournament with the intention of seeking [[Black market/Legends|black market]] opportunities, despite the tournament being only for those invited. The companion's efforts were rewarded when a [[Zeltron/Legends|Zeltron]] [[Unidentified Zeltron gambler|gambler]] at Flynn's tournament lost after putting up some rare possessions as collateral on a loan.<ref name="Mission" />
{{Endgame}}

==Behind the scenes==
Zarro Flynn was mentioned in the Crew Skill Mission "Into the Sabacc Pit" in the [[2011]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', developed by [[BioWare]]. The information regarding the mission's outcome was later removed from the game.<ref name="Mission" />
